entities.summary: Taxeringskalendern is the Swedish term for the directory that contains public information on taxable income and capital of all the individuals aged 18 and above in Sweden. The Swedish Tax Agency maintains high levels of legal transparency regarding citizens’ financial information, comparable to Norway and Finland.
